name: Heidi E. Storz
tagline: Top rated Construction Litigation attorney in Broomfield, Colorado
education: Northern Illinois University College of Law
about: Heidi E. Storz is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2027. She works at Kerrane Storz, P.C., located in Broomfield, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Construction Litigation: Consumer to the surrounding community.
Heidi Storz completed legal studies at Northern Illinois University College of Law and graduated with the class of 1998. Heidi Storz passed the bar in 1999.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
